messages:
lina: FYI — big enterprise customer (AC-1789) says a sales-issued promo/credit from their PO didn’t apply; they're seeing real billing against usage after the contract started.
arjun: which promo/contract? I issued a manual credit note on the PO last week.
lina: Contract C-5502R, PO PO-98234. Promo code on the PO reads: ENT-2025-CONTRACT-50K. Sales notes say apply $50,000 credit upon first invoice.
arjun: yep that’s mine. I added a PO note: "apply ENT-2025-CONTRACT-50K to first invoice". I also emailed legal and ops.
jess: pinging finance. I’m not seeing a ledger credit for AC-1789 in the billing system. Can you paste the invoice id?
lina: customer shared invoice INV-2025-0134 — they attached the PO. They say tokens consumed Apr 1–7 and invoice shows full charge. support-bot: automated billing sync job completed at 2026-04-03T03:22Z, no applyable promo found for account AC-1789.
sam: likely mismatch on contract id mapping. Quick repro I ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILL_KEY" \
  https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/AC-1789/charges
```
response snippet: `{ "invoice": "INV-2025-0134", "credits_applied": [], "notes": [] }`

sam: logs show the PO note was ingested but promo lookup failed due to extra whitespace on the PO tag: " ENT-2025-CONTRACT-50K" (leading space) — our matcher is strict.
arjun: oh dang. I probably copy/pasted from the PDF. sorry.
jess: OK. We need two things: 1) manual ledger adjustment for INV-2025-0134 (credit $50,000) referencing PO-98234 and C-5502R, and 2) a fix/patch for the PO tag matcher so future cases don't slip.
lina: customer is asking for ETA; can finance post the adjustment and I'll notify them?
jess: I can create an internal adjustment ticket and post the credit today, but need confirmation from sales that amount is final.
arjun: confirmed. $50,000 credit. Please include note: "Sales manual credit per PO-98234 / C-5502R — ENT-2025-CONTRACT-50K".
jess: copying required details into accounting ticket AT-7621 now. Will post adjustment and reply with ledger id when complete.
sam: I’ll open a bug for the strict whitespace matcher: BUG-4412. Quick fix is to trim PO tag values during ingestion. Will aim for a hotfix deploy in next patch window.
lina: thanks all. Once jess posts the ledger id I’ll send the customer a confirmation and updated invoice.
arjun: I'll also message the customer contact to apologize and confirm credit applied once you share the ledger id.
support-bot: accounting adjustment AT-7621 created by jess. Status: pending. Assigned: jess.
jess: adjustment posted. Ledger reference: LED-90011. I added memo: "Manual credit per PO-98234 / C-5502R — ENT-2025-CONTRACT-50K". Invoice INV-2025-0134 now shows credit balance $50,000 and net due updated.
lina: :white_check_mark: I notified the customer and they replied :thumbsup: — they asked if we can put a PO note to prevent future misses.
arjun: I fixed the PO text in my sales records. Sam, once BUG-4412 is in, can you add a one-off backfill to re-run ingestion for open POs older than 30 days?
sam: yes, will add a backfill task to BUG-4412. Plan: trim tags + backfill for POs in last 60 days. Schedule: patch tomorrow, backfill after verification.
lina: perfect. Closing loop here — thanks everyone. Will log this as CS-ESCAL-421 in our tracker for postmortem.
